title: Platform checklist: platform-core.json still describes the Installed Apps entry that #36933 retires
body:
triage#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZKP5YM48rWMWTS7wE

Filing gate: ① a stale test-checklist text, filed by triage at repo:objectstack#3's request (mailbox #36743, comment 7128073202, item 2). Source: dev report 7128030981 on #36834, for PR #36933.

Blocked-by: #36933

## What is false

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json` still describes Setup's Installed Apps entry, around lines 2393, 2404 and 2441. PR #36933 retires that entry into the single Packages entry. After it lands, a checklist run follows steps through a page that no longer exists.

reach: the people and agents running the platform checklist. There is no end-user effect.

## Expected

The items describe the single Packages entry as #36933 ships it, or are retired where they test only the removed entry.

## Order

Open draft PR #34223 also edits this file. Land after #34223, or fold this change into it if its owner agrees, to avoid a conflict.
